sentence: This project builds mass spectrometry methods to find out how mutations that cause progranulin deficiency harm lysosomes and lead to frontotemporal dementia.
This project studies how the cells that secrete the corneal lens control its shape, using the fruit fly Drosophila melanogaster.
This project tests whether combining static and dynamic risk improves the prediction of sudden cardiac death, using deep learning methods.
This project studies how early kidney fibrosis relates to heart disease, using deep learning on imaging data, genetic sequencing and health record data.
This project tries to find out how to control the niche around human pluripotent stem cells so they make more working skeletal muscle cells.
This project studies methylation changes in a type of RNA in alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma, a childhood sarcoma, to look for possible treatment targets.
This project tries to find out how the immune checkpoint proteins control pain and the pain relief that opioids give.
This project tests how safe and how well a nanoemulsion form of cannabidiol works, compared with usual cannabidiol, against neuropathic pain caused by chemotherapy.
This project studies how a protein that binds single-strand DNA controls end-joining, a repair pathway that is more active in many cancer cells.
This project builds and tests a computer model that predicts how animal cell types are determined, using nematode worms.
This project builds a clinical workflow product that brings pharmacogenetic analysis of sequencing data into routine clinical workflows.
This project tests a combination of treatments to control islet autoimmunity and increase beta cell mass and function in type 1 diabetes.
This project studies how the vaginal microbiome and psychological stress affect how precancerous cervical lesions progress to cancer.
This project explains statistical methods for finding genes that influence complex traits and mental illnesses in twin, family and sequencing studies.
This project studies how tumor-associated plasmacytoid dendritic cells work in human liver cancer during HIV infection and immunotherapy.
This project builds an MRI technique to image the lung while people breathe freely, and tests it in healthy subjects and smokers.
This project improves technologies that sort and profile cells by their nucleic acids to study tumor evolution and cell therapies.
This project studies how a fungal model organism makes telomerase RNA from mRNA.
This project refines and tests a personalized treatment that aims to reduce suicidal thoughts and behaviors.
